set.body:
Replace recognition by prior dataset occurrence with an explicit custodian directory. Keep custody separate from placement and stewardship.

Acceptance criteria

1. Operator registers a custodian by stable ID and display name before its first dataset. Creating a dataset requires a currently eligible custodian and normal project authority.
2. Migrate pre-existing UUIDs without guessing institutions or merging custodians by name. Existing releases, grants and custody references pass the historical compatibility check.
3. The packaged creation form defaults the sole eligible custodian, lists names when several are eligible, and explains an empty list. Retrying creation after an option becomes inactive cannot assign it.
4. A fresh installation with a project and zero datasets accepts its first deposit without asking the researcher for a UUID.

Verification

Exercise clean bootstrap, existing-catalog migration, zero/one/multiple eligible choices and stale-form rejection. Compare old and new release identities.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC01: Register named custodians and use them on first deposit
